title: Static Split-Elytra Beetle
description: One original stylised beetle with a low abdominal underbody, broad short pronotum, separate forward head, two complete convex elytra divided by a genuine narrow centre seam, two small lateral eyes, paired bent clubbed antennae, two short curved mandibles and six distinctly angled tapering legs rooted at the thorax. Each leg meets a small complete two-tip ground foot. All new whole profiles and coordinates; not a tortoise with recoloured scutes, an extra pair of old legs, a bee ornament extracted from a scene or an existing animal body reused. Twenty-five closed editable meshes, four constant opaque PBR materials, no textures. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, no scene or separate component counts. Artistic static exoskeletal silhouette, not a species diagnosis, scientific anatomy, true layered shell, moving wing, gait, rig, animation, biological function, collision or stability certification.
